item.title: West Point Founders Day Celebrations Worldwide
item.description: West Point Societies and graduates around the world are gathering to celebrate Founders Day, honoring the legacy of the United States Military Academy and the values of Duty, Honor, Country. With more than 100 events worldwide, these celebrations strengthen the bonds that connect generations of the Long Gray Line.

item.title: The LT Who Would be SUPT
item.description: While preparing the 2025 Register of Graduates &amp; Former Cadets, a fascinating piece of West Point history emerges: the story of Medal of Honor recipient Albert Leopold Mills, Class of 1879—the only first lieutenant ever appointed Superintendent of the U.S. Military Academy—and the lasting reforms he brought to the Corps.

item.title: West Point Cadets Shine as 70th Brigade Boxing Open Highlights Grit, Skill, and New Champions
item.description: The 70th West Point Brigade Boxing Open highlighted determination and talent as new and returning champions secured titles and prepared for NCBA regionals.

item.title: Forging Leaders: West Point Cadets Tested in Norwegian Foot March
item.description: Over 2,000 West Point cadets completed the 18.6‑mile Norwegian Foot March, pushing through cold, dark terrain to build resilience and leader readiness.

item.title: CDT Larry Pickett '28 Receives Soldier’s Medal
item.description: CDT Larry Pickett '28 receives the Soldier’s Medal at West Point’s Founder’s Day after saving a man from a vehicle fire in a heroic act of selfless service.

item.title: Podcast: An Army Officer’s Mission to Space with COL Anne McClain ’02
item.description: From missile defense to the big screen, LTG (R) Dan Karbler reveals how he helped Oscar-winning director Kathryn Bigelow bring military authenticity to A House of Dynamite. Tune in to this WPAOG Podcast for behind-the-scenes insights on leadership and filmmaking.

item.title: West Point Mountaineering Team Tackles Catskills Terrain During Winter Training
item.description: After the recent snowfall and freezing temperatures, the West Point Mountaineering Team took advantage of the conditions and conducted an ice climbing trip to the Catskill Mountains.

item.title: West Point Gymnastics Captures USAG National Title
item.description: Army West Point gymnastics made program history, capturing its first USAG Collegiate National Team Championship while earning seven All-American honors and an individual national title from Cadet Nick Lester.

item.title: WPAOG Hudson Valley Program Holds Community Forum in Highland Falls
item.description: The West Point Association of Graduates held a Community Open Forum in Highland Falls on March 24, where local residents learned about WPAOG’s partnership with the local government and had the opportunity to ask questions and share perspectives on the future economic development of their town.

item.title: Cadet Marathon Team Honors Fallen USMA Graduates
item.description: More than 800 participants gathered at West Point for the Fallen Comrades Half Marathon, honoring 13 graduates who gave their lives in service to the nation. Each mile of the course told a story of sacrifice, reinforcing the enduring bond between cadets and the Long Gray Line.

item.title: Class of 2029 Crest Unveiling
item.description: The West Point Class of 2029 unveiled its class crest, marking a defining moment in their first year at the Academy. Centered on the motto “Hold the Line,” the crest reflects the class’s shared experiences, challenges, and commitment to Duty, Honor, Country. With symbolism tied to both their Beast experience and their 50-Year Affiliation Class.

item.title: Army Baseball Captures Star with Win Over Navy
item.description: Army wins a tense 4–3 rubber match against Navy on March 29, securing the baseball star in the Army-Navy Star Series behind CDT Trey Ates’ standout performance and clutch hitting.

item.title: West Point Cadets and Old Grads Unite to Remember Bataan
item.description: The 37th Annual Bataan Memorial Death March was held at White Sands Missile Range, bringing together not only the Army community, but the West Point community.

item.title: 2026 West Point Graduates Selected for General Officer Promotion
item.description: Join us in congratulating the current listing of West Point graduates who were selected for general officer promotion.
